anchorDocument(string,string,string).details: Documents are content-addressed — IPFS CID is the proof.      Anyone can verify: fetch CID from IPFS, hash matches on-chain.      Can be called before or after finalise().      After finalise(): documents can be added but CIDs cannot change. Document types:   "appraisal"    — Professional valuation by Dr. Lori Verderame   "provenance"   — Ownership and acquisition history   "insurance"    — Insurance certificate and coverage   "trademark"    — UK00003897277 registration certificate   "declaration"  — Irrevocable legal ownership declaration   "payment"      — Lloyds Bank payment confirmation (provenance)

constructor.details: Immediately creates the initial asset record.      Call anchorDocument() for each supporting document.      Call finalise() to make the record immutable.

finalise().details: After finalisation:      - Asset name, artist, location, year, medium cannot change      - FMV range cannot change      - Legal owner cannot change      - Existing document CIDs cannot change      - New documents CAN still be added      Recommended: anchor all key documents before finalising.      Required documents before finalising:        - "appraisal" — must be anchored        - "provenance" — must be anchored        - "declaration" — must be anchored

updateFMV(uint256,uint256,uint256).details: Once finalised, FMV is immutable.      Use if appraiser provides updated valuation.
